claims_boundary: This public contract declares probe invariants and consequences without revealing probe-specific targets or expected result sets.

sealed_payload.availability_before_reveal: maintainer-only; absent from the public PR branch
sealed_payload.required_pre_run_disposition: The maintainer verifies the bytes against this commitment, reviews the complete oracle, and records disposition before authorizing the graded run.
sealed_payload.reveal_rule: After graded outputs are fixed, add the exact sealed file to the experiment branch and verify its byte length and sha256 before any probe result is scored.
sealed_payload.builder_boundary: The pipeline builder may review this public contract and commitment but must not inspect the sealed payload before reveal.

probes.invariant: Every declared class-1 canonical payload is reproduced byte-for-byte from identical declared inputs, tool versions, and parameters.
probes.decision_consequence: Any mismatch stops the run and rejects the deterministic-stage claim.
required_reporting: confirmation that run and event envelopes were excluded

probes.invariant: One withheld-ground-truth read and one out-of-manifest repository read are both denied and individually recorded.
probes.decision_consequence: Any successful read invalidates the run and every extraction-quality claim.

probes.invariant: A synthetic insertion and renumbering cannot create false logical-anchor continuity; dependency impact is scored for both precision and recall.
probes.decision_consequence: Report anchor survival, false continuity, and impact precision and recall; no anchor promise is promoted by this descriptive probe alone.

probes.invariant: A single substantive table-cell change is detected and its dependency impact is scored for both precision and recall.
probes.decision_consequence: Report the exact semantic diff and impact scores; unrelated impact flags count against precision.

probes.invariant: Removing one in-scope capture while holding the census oracle fixed prevents graded candidate emission and reports the omission.
probes.decision_consequence: Failure to detect the omission rejects the census-completeness gate.

probes.invariant: A one-byte capture corruption fails digest verification before parsing and emits no downstream artifacts.
probes.decision_consequence: Any pre-verdict parse or downstream emission rejects the fail-closed pipeline claim.

probes.invariant: A preselected subset is processed by a genuinely different model lineage; agreement never promotes and disagreement raises review priority.
probes.decision_consequence: If genuine independence is unavailable, report the probe as not executable and make no independence claim.
